title: More flow through one pipe
hook: Change volume-flow rate and predict fluid speed.
misconception: fluid speed stays fixed when volume-flow rate doubles.
objective: Apply v = Q/A to compare fluid speed when volume-flow rate changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With steady incompressible flow in a pipe of fixed cross-sectional area, v = Q/A. When volume-flow rate doubles, fluid speed becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model v = Q/A; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider steady incompressible flow in a pipe of fixed cross-sectional area, with a nonzero initial result. If volume-flow rate triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on fluid speed?
recall.why: Apply v = Q/A under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
